sloka: अपराधम् कमुद्दिश्य त्यक्ष्यामीष्टमहम् सुतम् ।जीवलोको यदा सर्वो रामस्याह गुणस्तवम् ॥२-१२-१०॥
transliteration: aparādham kamuddiśya tyakṣyāmīṣṭamaham sutam ।jīvaloko yadā sarvo rāmasyāha guṇastavam ॥2-12-10॥

translations.english: When all living beings of this world are extoling the virtues of Rama, for what crime should I abandon my beloved son?
